Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL218 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
